column1: How the matter was addressed in the audit

We obtained an understanding of the relevant controls
management had in place and newly implemented
in relation to the adoption of the new standard and
tested for implementation. We performed the following
procedures; -
• We obtained an understanding of the Company’s
process for estimating the ECL;
• We analyzed the expected credit loss models
against IFRS 9 guidelines;
• We tested the design effectiveness of the ECL
models to understand the key assumptions behind
the models.
• We tested the key controls over the administration
of the expected credit loss model
• We tested the completeness of financial assets
evaluated to determine whether all assets were
included in the calculations by evaluating the assets
included on the statement of financial position and
whether they met the definition of a financial asset.
• We picked a sample and performed procedures to
determine accuracy for exposures assessed on an
individual basis
• For forward looking assumptions used by the
Group, we held discussions with management and
corroborated the assumptions using both internal
and publicly available information; and
• We assessed the accuracy of the relevant disclosures
in the financial statements.
